reason: I'm not paying £14-18 a month for collagen when I've never seen proper evidence it does anything for skin or joints once you digest it. Halal is a must for me, but that just gets it onto the shortlist, it doesn't prove it works.
objection: Reviews on the brand's own site don't convince me, and I don't know if collagen actually works. On top of that, an unflavoured scoop every day sounds like a chore I'd drop after a week.
would_change_my_mind: Independent clinical evidence for the actual product or dose, plus the halal certifier named so I can check it myself, and ideally a cheaper trial size so I'm not committing to a full pouch.
